Name: basic_attack
Description: Standard weapon attack used as a baseline for combo tracking

Name: heal_wave
Description: Small restorative wave that stabilizes allies and teaches support timing

Name: fireball
Description: Hurls a fire projectile that applies burn and can ignite oil or explosives

Name: gust
Description: Pushes enemies and objects while shaping existing elemental effects

Name: spark_jolt
Description: Quick lightning bolt that rewards movement and conductive surfaces

Name: frost_shard
Description: Launches a piercing ice shard that slows and primes brittle targets

Name: stone_spike
Description: Raises a damaging spike from ground or unstable terrain

Name: ignite_weapon
Description: Coats equipped weapon in flame and improves burn on weapon hits

Name: fire_punch
Description: Channels fire into gloves or fists for explosive close range hits

Name: blink
Description: Converts storm casting movement habits into a short tactical teleport

Name: conductive_surge
Summary: Area chain lightning on wet targets
Description: Detonates conductive arcs across wet enemies and puddles

Name: fire_tornado
Description: Sustained vortex of flame requiring mastery of both fire to wind orders

Name: explosion
Description: Detonates volatile targets or marked zones after repeated barrel interactions

Name: chain_detonation
Description: Marks multiple volatile points and detonates them in sequence

Name: backdraft
Summary: Oil fire wave pushed by wind
Description: Turns burning oil and gust pressure into a directed flame surge

Name: sky_lance
Description: Rewards airborne casting with a descending high velocity elemental lance

Name: stone_breaker
Description: Heavy earth shockwave unlocked by melee into earth discipline

Name: flame_slash
Description: Converts repeated fire weapon coatings into a ranged weapon fire arc

Name: shatter_squall
Description: Wind detonates chilled targets into a sweeping shard storm

Name: glacial_upthrust
Description: Earth spike erupts through chilled ground and launches foes higher

Name: magnetic_lash
Description: Hooks armored foes or metal objects with a charged pulling arc

Name: restorative_current
Description: Successful evasive healing grants a short moving protection current
